review_method: AI-assisted review against the frozen v2 rubric and exact supplied rule excerpts; not independently reviewed by a Magic judge.

results.notes: Direct answer and scope for MTR 3.9 are correct, but the response includes a visibly incorrect d6-to-four-options mapping, then self-corrects mid-example and adds a long sequential-coin-flip aside. Prefer shuffled slips for arbitrary choices and keep this simple question concise.
Correctly states counters and an Aura’s continuous bonus are not copied; CR 707.2 supports the general answer.
Correct: fight damage is not combat damage, so double strike has no effect and each creature deals its power once.

The core process is correctly cited, but the unsolicited hypothetical is wrong. “Enters with a +1/+1 counter” and “enters tapped” replacements can both apply to the same entering event; neither automatically stops the other. Avoid invented example effect text.
Correctly excludes the creature made illegal by protection and cites both CR 702.16b and the target legality rule. No die-roll guidance is mixed into the answer.
